description: STANDARD, canonical entry point for "which WebAZ account am I connected as?", OAuth scopes or expiry; not webaz_profile. Read-only read_public grant; returns connected, handle, masked account_id_hint, scopes, expires_at. If disconnected, OAuth reconnects; api_key-only webaz_profile is not a substitute. No tokens, keys, email, address or other PII.
name: webaz_connection_status
